source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 7: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Denominator mein ek hi linear factor \(x + 2\) teen dafa aa raha hai, yani \((x + 2)^3\). Yeh Case-II hai (repeated linear factor).
Repeated factor ke liye har power ka alag fraction likhna parta hai: \((x + 2)\), \((x + 2)^2\), \((x + 2)^3\).
Plan: \(x = -2\) rakh kar \(C\), phir coefficients compare kar ke \(A\) aur \(B\), aur aakhir mein power rule se integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x^2 - 3}{(x + 2)^3}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: partial fractions, Case-II. Fraction proper hai (upar degree 2, neeche degree 3). Case-II mein sirf ek root hota hai, is liye baaqi constants coefficients compare kar ke milte hain.

Partial fractions likhein
\[\dfrac{x^2 - 3}{(x + 2)^3} = \dfrac{A}{x + 2} + \dfrac{B}{(x + 2)^2} + \dfrac{C}{(x + 2)^3}\]
\[x^2 - 3 = A(x + 2)^2 + B(x + 2) + C \quad (1)\]
Kyun: \((x + 2)^3\) ke liye power 1 se 3 tak teen fractions. Agar sirf \(\frac{C}{(x + 2)^3}\) likhein to upar sirf constant aa sakta hai, jab ke humare paas \(x^2 - 3\) hai; is liye teeno chahiye. Phir \((x + 2)^3\) se multiply kiya.

(1) mein \(x = -2\) rakhein
\[4 - 3 = C\]
\[C = 1\]
Kyun: \(x = -2\) par \(x + 2 = 0\), is liye \(A\) aur \(B\) wale terms zero. Left side: \((-2)^2 - 3 = 1\).

Coefficients compare karein
\[x^2:\ 1 = A\]
\[x:\ 0 = 4A + B,\ B = -4\]
Kyun: \(A(x + 2)^2 = A(x^2 + 4x + 4)\) kholne se \(x^2\) ka coefficient \(A\) aur \(x\) ka \(4A + B\) banta hai. Left side \(x^2 - 3\) mein \(x^2\) ka coefficient 1 aur \(x\) ka 0 hai. Is liye \(A = 1\) aur \(4 + B = 0\).

Integral lein
\[\int \left(\dfrac{1}{x + 2} - 4(x + 2)^{-2} + (x + 2)^{-3}\right)dx\]
\[= \ln|x + 2| - 4\cdot\dfrac{(x + 2)^{-1}}{-1} + \dfrac{(x + 2)^{-2}}{-2}\]
\[= \ln|x + 2| + \dfrac{4}{x + 2} - \dfrac{1}{2(x + 2)^2} + c\]
Kyun: Pehla term \(\ln\) deta hai. Baaqi do terms ko negative power mein likh kar power rule \(\int (x + a)^n\,dx = \frac{(x + a)^{n+1}}{n + 1}\) lagaya: power ek barhao aur nayi power se divide karo.
Dhyan dein: Sirf power \(-1\) par \(\ln\) aata hai; \((x + 2)^{-2}\) ka integral \(\ln\) nahi, \(-(x + 2)^{-1}\) hai.

Tasdeeq (constant term)
\[4A + 2B + C = 4 - 8 + 1 = -3 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: (1) ke right side ka constant term \(4A + 2B + C\) hai aur left side ka \(-3\). Values rakhne se dono barabar aaye, is liye constants sahi hain.

blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 301) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (vii) hai: \(\ln|x + 2| + \frac{4}{x + 2} - \frac{1}{2(x + 2)^2} + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
